reason: Provides BYOK integration for OpenAI-compatible language model providers, with per-provider endpoints, API keys, text streaming, and HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy configuration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入任意 OpenAI 兼容模型服务，支持自带 API key、文本流式响应以及按供应商配置 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OpenAI-compatible model providers with user-supplied API keys, text streaming, and per-provider HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy settings.

capabilities: Connects to user-configured OpenAI-compatible model APIs
Uses user-provided API keys or environment-variable references
Routes provider requests through configured HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 proxies
Streams text responses using OpenAI Chat Completions and SSE
